Team — tagging in Billing/AR. Quick notes from our side: 

- W-9: attached (w9-redwood-2027.pdf). That will satisfy the payee verification for the remit swap.
- Net terms: Finance can approve Net30 for this renewal provided we have a signed amendment and the PO references the correct legal entity. We log Net30 as a billing attribute on the subscription.
- PO format: procurement should include PO number, billing entity name (Helios Technologies LLC), remit email (payable@helios-corp.com), and payment instructions. We do not require a specific PDF template but we do need a PO number to apply to invoices.
- Promotional credit: Redwood Finance will approve a one-time credit up to $10,000 for capacity upsells executed and invoiced on or before the renewal effective date. We need the sales approval and callout in the amendment so AR can apply the credit to the first invoice.

Connor — please confirm the credit amount you want to commit to the customer so I can enter it into the amendment. Once PO and signed amendment are in, AR will route invoices to payable@helios-corp.com as requested.

Thanks,
